faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.sub: Everything you might want to know before your first round.
faq.dataA: RoundFair stores your data on your device and in your personal iCloud. RoundFair has no servers of its own and no access to your sessions, rounds or balances. Sharing a session with friends uses Apple's iCloud (CloudKit), so your group's data stays inside Apple's ecosystem and never passes through a RoundFair account.
faq.shareA: RoundFair shares a session through iCloud (CloudKit), so everyone sees the same rounds and balances live on their own iPhone. Every participant needs an iCloud account on their device, but nobody has to create a separate RoundFair account. Sharing is optional, and you can also run a session on your own.
faq.costA: RoundFair is free to download on the App Store. Open it, create a session and start tracking rounds straight away. No purchase is required to get going.
faq.offlineA: Yes. RoundFair is offline-first, so you can add rounds, see whose turn it is and settle the bill without any connection. iCloud sharing is optional and syncs automatically when your device is back online, so a weak signal in a bar never blocks the session.
faq.currencyA: Every RoundFair session has its own currency. You pick it when you create the session, and all amounts, balances and the final settlement are shown in that currency. That lets you run one session for a night out at home and another for a trip abroad.
faq.exportQ: Can I share the overview with the group?
faq.exportA: Yes. RoundFair can export the session as plain text with participants, rounds and balances. You can share that overview through any app, such as a group chat or email, so everyone can see who owes what.
faq.tauntA: Taunt notifications are optional, playful reminders during a session for whoever hasn't paid in a while. They are scheduled on your device rather than sent from a server, and you can turn them off at any time in settings.
faq.turnQ: How do I know whose turn it is to buy a round?
faq.turnA: RoundFair's Up now view shows whose turn it is to buy the next round and who is behind. If nobody wants to decide, the spin wheel can pick someone at random.
faq.splitQ: How do I split a bar tab fairly?
faq.splitA: RoundFair tracks every round during the night, so you can see who paid and who is behind. When you're ready, use Split the bill to settle. A consumption overview shows who had what and the cost per person, so the split reflects what people actually drank.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy (RoundFair)
privacy.description: RoundFair collects no data. None. No analytics, no trackers, no ads, no servers, everything stays on your device and in your personal iCloud.
privacy.intro: RoundFair is built so that your data never leaves your control. There are no analytics, no trackers, no ads, no third-party SDKs, and no servers operated by RoundFair.
privacy.whereBody: Everything you enter in RoundFair, sessions, friends, rounds, locations, and prices, is stored on your device and in your personal iCloud (CloudKit). RoundFair has no servers and no access to any of it.
privacy.shareBody: When you share a session with friends, the sharing happens directly between participants' iCloud accounts through Apple's CloudKit. No data passes through anyone else.
privacy.photosBody: Photos for locations are added through the system photo picker. RoundFair only receives the single image you choose, never access to your photo library.
privacy.notifBody: Any notifications RoundFair shows are scheduled locally on your device. Nothing is sent from a server.
privacy.deleteIntro: Your data is yours to remove at any time:
privacy.deleteLi1: Delete a session to remove it and its rounds.
privacy.deleteLi2: Delete the app to remove all data from your device and your iCloud.
